curation_strategy: Arc obligations were satisfied first: six passages for Richard's deterioration tracking his psychological unraveling from undisciplined youth through hollow-eyed collapse; five for Lady Dedlock's secret tracing composure to catastrophe; four for Jo's suffering moving from systemic exclusion to harrowing testimony. Expert assignments then matched Rosen's social-critique passages to fog and Chancery segments, Leigh's character-development passages to Richard's arc and the moral-vision discussion, and Woodcourt's humor and close-reading passages to the Aloud segment. Seven structure passages fill the thematic_depth, narrative_technique, and plot_advancement gaps identified in the episode's demand profile, distributed across segments where they add the most analytical value without duplicating arc or expert content.

curation_assignments.segment_name: The Fog and the System: Opening the Case
curation_assignments.rationale: The primordial fog-and-mud opening perfectly satisfies Daniel Rosen's demand for atmosphere_setting and social_critique, launching the episode's central metaphor.

curation_assignments.segment_name: The Fog and the System: Opening the Case
curation_assignments.rationale: Locates fog at its thickest near Chancery, directly linking atmosphere to institutional corruption for the opening segment.

curation_assignments.segment_name: The Fog and the System: Opening the Case
curation_assignments.rationale: The extended satirical tableau of the Lord Chancellor and court staff epitomizes Rosen's social-critique demand while anchoring the opening.

curation_assignments.segment_name: Richard's Slow Poison: Ambition and Will
curation_assignments.rationale: Esther's reflection on Richard's undisciplined nature rooted in educational systems establishes the arc's psychological foundation.

curation_assignments.segment_name: Richard's Slow Poison: Ambition and Will
curation_assignments.rationale: Richard walking through Lincoln's Inn while the narrator reflects on Chancery's many victims captures his deterioration in progress.

curation_assignments.segment_name: Richard's Slow Poison: Ambition and Will
curation_assignments.rationale: Richard's confession to Woodcourt — trapped, purposeless, yet demanding acceptance — is the arc's psychological core.

curation_assignments.segment_name: Richard's Slow Poison: Ambition and Will
curation_assignments.rationale: Esther's meditation on Richard's forced optimism wearing into permanent anxiety is among the novel's most devastating character observations.

curation_assignments.segment_name: Character and Circumstance: The Novel's Moral Vision
curation_assignments.rationale: The narrator's analysis of how injustice breeds injustice and Richard transfers his enemy from abstraction to Jarndyce is the arc's thematic climax.

curation_assignments.segment_name: Character and Circumstance: The Novel's Moral Vision
curation_assignments.rationale: Esther's chronicle of Richard's haunted states — wandering, absorbed, bitten nails — shows the arc's final physical collapse.

curation_assignments.segment_name: Jo's True Name: What the System Makes
curation_assignments.rationale: The narrator's exploration of Jo's alienation from literate society is the most powerful single statement of the arc's social critique.

curation_assignments.segment_name: Jo's True Name: What the System Makes
curation_assignments.rationale: The direct address to Jo affirming his love as grace against systemic rejection perfectly anchors the arc's emotional and moral weight.

curation_assignments.segment_name: Jo's True Name: What the System Makes
curation_assignments.rationale: Dickens's scathing critique of Victorian charity treating Jo as less worthy than a foreign savage is the arc's sharpest satirical moment.

curation_assignments.segment_name: Character and Circumstance: The Novel's Moral Vision
curation_assignments.rationale: Jo's dialect account of being chivied and worritted to skins and bones by the legal system closes the arc with harrowing human testimony.

curation_assignments.segment_name: A Woman's Secret, A Nation's Secret
curation_assignments.rationale: Lady Dedlock's first appearance at her dreary estate, observing the rain with uncharacteristic agitation, establishes the arc's opening mystery.

curation_assignments.segment_name: A Woman's Secret, A Nation's Secret
curation_assignments.rationale: The cat-and-mouse social performance between Lady Dedlock and Tulkinghorn across many days is the arc's central dramatic engine.

curation_assignments.segment_name: A Woman's Secret, A Nation's Secret
curation_assignments.rationale: Lady Dedlock's stillness as her own secret is read aloud to her by firelight is the arc's most cinematically tense revelation.

curation_assignments.segment_name: The Case Never Closes: Why Bleak House Still Matters
curation_assignments.rationale: The collapse of Lady Dedlock's facade — all broken down — is the arc's catastrophic turning point and resonates into the closing segment.

curation_assignments.segment_name: A Woman's Secret, A Nation's Secret
curation_assignments.rationale: The narrator's reflection on Lady Dedlock's self-suppression destroying her capacity for compassion gives the arc its thematic depth.

curation_assignments.segment_name: The Machinery of Chancery: Who Profits, Who Suffers
curation_assignments.rationale: The fog-matched condemnation of Chancery as pestilent and sinful drives Rosen's strongest social-critique demand in the Chancery deep-dive.

curation_assignments.segment_name: The Machinery of Chancery: Who Profits, Who Suffers
curation_assignments.rationale: The explicit argument that English law's one great principle is self-perpetuation is the Marxist critic's ideal text for institutional analysis.

curation_assignments.segment_name: The Machinery of Chancery: Who Profits, Who Suffers
curation_assignments.rationale: Jarndyce's description of the decaying street owned by costs gives concrete material evidence of Chancery's human destruction.

curation_assignments.segment_name: The Machinery of Chancery: Who Profits, Who Suffers
curation_assignments.rationale: Boythorn's explosive satirical proposal to blow Chancery to atoms satisfies both social critique and humor while enlivening the deep-dive.

curation_assignments.segment_name: The Music of Dickens: Reading Bleak House Aloud
curation_assignments.rationale: Guppy's comic coinage 'London particular' is a perfect close-reading set piece for humor and Dickens's ear for idiolect.

curation_assignments.segment_name: The Music of Dickens: Reading Bleak House Aloud
curation_assignments.rationale: The sardonic joke that Jarndyce and Jarndyce has passed into a joke is an ideal passage for close reading of Dickens's dark comic technique.

curation_assignments.segment_name: The Music of Dickens: Reading Bleak House Aloud
curation_assignments.rationale: The narrator's direct address to Jo balancing compassion and irony exemplifies Dickens's dual-narrative voice and emotional register for close reading.

curation_assignments.segment_name: The Machinery of Chancery: Who Profits, Who Suffers
curation_assignments.rationale: Dickens's preface citing real Chancery cases fills the narrative_technique gap while grounding the Chancery deep-dive in documentary authority.

curation_assignments.segment_name: The Machinery of Chancery: Who Profits, Who Suffers
curation_assignments.rationale: The rhetorical question connecting Dedlock world to Jo's existence is a key narrative-technique passage demonstrating Dickens's structural irony.

curation_assignments.segment_name: The Fog and the System: Opening the Case
curation_assignments.rationale: The moonlit natural world concluding with Chancery's corrupting pipes fills the thematic_depth gap in the opening segment with lyrical force.

curation_assignments.segment_name: The Case Never Closes: Why Bleak House Still Matters
curation_assignments.rationale: Chesney Wold's silence and Lady Dedlock's burial shrouded in rumour fills the thematic_depth gap in the closing while serving all three arcs' aftermath.

curation_assignments.segment_name: A Woman's Secret, A Nation's Secret
curation_assignments.rationale: Lady Dedlock's sharp reaction to Hawdon's death fills the plot_advancement structural gap and advances the secret arc at a pivotal revelation.

curation_assignments.segment_name: Jo's True Name: What the System Makes
curation_assignments.rationale: Jo's account of the veiled lady paying him a sovereign fills the plot_advancement structural gap while deepening the intersection of Jo and Lady Dedlock arcs.

curation_assignments.segment_name: Character and Circumstance: The Novel's Moral Vision
curation_assignments.rationale: Esther's clinical observation of Richard's hollow eyes, chapped lips, and bitten nails gives the traditionalist critic vivid textual evidence for character deterioration.
